name: @helm/counterfactual-runtime
description: HELM Counterfactual Engine: ex-post alternative worlds anchored to the historical decision boundary, two retrospective lenses (as known then, with hindsight) kept apart, model-based estimates labelled as such with causal support judged separately from the Causal Graph, layered comparison of expected, actual and alternative — with no regret score, no verdict and no fake certainty.
